segments.text: On the contrarie part, many good Christians leaue to apply the comfort of the gospel to themselues, and onely haue regard to their owne sinnes, and Gods infinite vengeance. And euen when Satan accuseth them, they will not sticke to giue eare to Sathan, & also accuse themselues: & so they are brought into fearefull terrors, and often draw neere to desperation.
